title: 第25章 双枪到手第26章 猎物换物资
content_zh:
虎哥听完兴奋得很，我全都要了，不过狼肉可比野猪肉便宜些。
野猪肉三块五一斤，没处理过的野猪三块一斤，狼、野兔、野鸡都是两块五一斤！
张昊宇想了想，觉得没问题！我需要一把五六半用来打猎，不知道虎哥有没有办法搞到？要是有的话，大黑星也来一把，成色要好的那种。
虎哥琢磨了一下，我认识一个人有你想要的东西！价钱可不便宜哦。
五六半要二百二十块，大黑星要一百八十块，子弹都是一毛钱一颗！
“行，子弹各来一千颗！”
虎哥问：“啥时候能交易。”
“现在就可以，我们的猎物就在不远处的小树林里！”
虎哥点点头，半小时后在小树林交易。
张昊宇出门直奔小树林，“放出一头三百多斤的野猪、两头狼、八只野兔、七只野鸡！”
他点上一支烟，用神识观察着周围的情况！半小时后，虎哥带着四个人，拉着一辆板车来到小树林！
双方互相验货，张昊宇看了看那两把枪，都是全新的，枪油还在，应该就开过几枪，他挺满意的！
虎哥的手下也把野猪等称了重，给了张昊宇九百一十块钱，交易顺利完成。虎哥带人拉着野猪等走了！
张昊宇把枪和子弹收进空间，往家里走去！回到院子外面。
他用神识观察了一下，院子里的人都在睡觉，没人起来！
他悄悄回到房间，躺在床上却怎么也睡不着。
闪身进空间，看了看今晚的收入，差不多有两千块，还有两把枪！
服下一滴灵液，开始修炼“玄天长生诀”，修炼结束后，又练了一遍太极、八极拳、军体拳……
用意念清理一下，吃了几个包子，七八分饱！出了空间，往床上一躺，眯一会儿！
迷迷糊糊中，被叫醒吃饭，张昊宇爬起来洗把脸，吃完饭，和家人出门接着钓鱼！

今天一家人来到城外的野河，把准备好的面团扔进河里，用神识观察河里，张昊宇心里一喜。
这河里有鱼群，好多大鱼，不光有鱼，还发现河里有甲鱼…
开始收鱼，把大量的鱼收进空间河里，还有好几只甲鱼也被收了进去！
忙活了两个多小时，钓上来几十条两斤以上的大鱼！两只五六斤以上的甲鱼！
“二哥，这乌龟能吃不？”
“这是甲鱼，可好吃了，还有营养，今晚吃红烧甲鱼！”
母亲问：“这玩意儿真好吃啊？都不会做！”
张昊宇回到：“我会做，今晚做给你尝尝，营养价值可高了，正好给大家补补…”
晓丽开口，“这么多鱼，我们咋拿回去呀？”
张昊宇想了想“小天，你去国营饭店问问他们要不要鱼，不要的话。
你去供销社找朱霸杰，让他帮忙骑三轮车过来拉回去！”
小天满口答应：“好的二哥。”半个小时后，弟弟带着两辆三轮车过来了，一个是朱霸杰，一个是国营饭店熊大厨的小徒弟！
朱霸杰看到鱼，哇塞“小宇兄弟，你也太厉害了吧？钓了这么多鱼？”
张昊宇掏出香烟，给两个人一人发了一支，“杰哥，你们咋一起来了？”
朱霸杰笑嘻嘻地说：“你弟弟说你叫我过来帮忙拉鱼，那我就来了！”
content_en:
Brother Tiger was very excited after hearing this. I wanted them all, but wolf meat was cheaper than wild boar meat.
Wild boar is three yuan and a half a pound, unprocessed wild boar is three yuan and a pound, and wolves, hares, and pheasants are all two yuan and a half!
Zhang Haoyu thought about it and thought it was okay! I need a 56 and a half for hunting. I wonder if Brother Hu can get it? If there is one, get some from Big Black Star too, the kind with better quality.
Brother Hu thought about it, I know someone who has what you want! The price is not cheap.
The five-six-and-a-half costs two hundred and twenty yuan, the big black star costs one hundred and eighty yuan, and the bullets are a dime each!
"Okay, a thousand bullets each!"
Brother Hu asked: "When can we trade?"
"You can do it now, our prey is in the woods not far away!"
Brother Hu nodded and traded in the woods half an hour later.
Zhang Haoyu went out and went straight to the woods, "released a wild boar weighing more than 300 kilograms, two wolves, eight hares, and seven pheasants!"
He lit a cigarette and observed the surrounding situation with his spiritual consciousness! Half an hour later, Brother Hu led four people and pulled a cart to the grove!
The two parties inspected each other's goods. Zhang Haoyu looked at the two guns. They were both brand new. The gun oil was still there. They must have been fired a few times. He was quite satisfied!
Brother Hu's men also weighed the wild boars and gave Zhang Haoyu 910 yuan, and the transaction was successfully completed. Brother Tiger and his men took the wild boar and left!
Zhang Haoyu put the gun and bullets into the space and walked home! Go back outside to the yard.
He observed with his spiritual consciousness that everyone in the yard was sleeping and no one got up!
He quietly returned to the room and lay on the bed but couldn't fall asleep.
He stepped into the space and looked at his income tonight. It was almost two thousand yuan, and there were two guns!
After taking a drop of spiritual liquid, I started to practice the "Xuantian Immortality Technique". After the practice, I practiced Tai Chi, Bajiquan, and Juntiquan again...
I cleaned it up with my mind, ate a few steamed buns, and felt about half full! After leaving the space, lie down on the bed and squint for a while!
In a daze, he was woken up to eat. Zhang Haoyu got up and washed his face. After eating, he went out with his family to continue fishing!
Today, the family came to the wild river outside the city, threw the prepared dough into the river, and observed the river with their spiritual consciousness. Zhang Haoyu felt happy.
There are schools of fish in this river, many big fish. Not only are there fish, but there are also turtles in the river...
Started to collect fish, a large number of fish were collected into the space river, and several turtles were also collected!
After working for more than two hours, I caught dozens of big fish weighing more than two kilograms! Two soft-shelled turtles weighing over five or six kilograms!
"Second brother, can this turtle be eaten?"
"This is turtle. It's delicious and nutritious. Let's eat braised turtle tonight!"
My mother asked: "Is this stuff so delicious? I don't even know how to cook it!"
Zhang Haoyu replied: "I know how to cook it. I will make it for you to try tonight. The nutritional value is very high. It is just a supplement for everyone..."
Xiaoli said, "There are so many fish, how can we take them back?"
Zhang Haoyu thought for a while, "Xiaotian, go to the state-owned restaurant and ask them if they want fish. If not.
Go to the supply and marketing cooperative to find Zhu Bajie and ask him to help you ride a tricycle to pull him back! "
Xiaotian promised: "Okay, second brother." Half an hour later, the younger brother came over with two tricycles. One was Zhu Bajie, and the other was the apprentice of Chef Xiong of the state-owned restaurant!
When Zhu Bajie saw the fish, he was like, "Brother Xiaoyu, are you so awesome? Have you caught so many fish?"
Zhang Haoyu took out cigarettes and gave one to each of the two people, "Brother Jie, why are you here together?"
Zhu Bajie said with a smile: "Your brother said you asked me to come over to help pull fish, so I will come!"
